item.title: Cable Selection Analysis — Interface Standards, Protocols, and Signal Integrity: Don't Let a Cheap Cable Drag Down Your Equipment
item.description:
About This Handbook

This handbook is not organized by brand and model, but by interface standards and protocols. The underlying dimensions of cables — interface standards (HDMI/DP/USB/Ethernet), protocol generations (HDMI 2.0/2.1, USB 3.2/4, Cat6/6a/7), bandwidth and power limits, and signal integrity principles — have been stable for years (the HDMI 2.1 standard dates to 2017, USB 3.2 to 2019, Cat6a to 2008), so they offer more long-term reference value than specific model numbers.
